description: Evaluation set of assignment A7 for the support-request router of A6. The expected results follow the platform's support guidelines in src/knowledge-base.json (KB01 to KB10) and were written before any evaluation run.
scoring: A case is correct when queue, urgency and needsHuman all equal the expected values. For a fallback case the decision must also come from the fallback (source "fallback") with the expected fallbackReason. Every case is sent several times; it counts as correct only if every repetition is correct.

scenarios.model: the normal server: the decision model answers
scenarios.model_error: a server started with a model id that does not exist (npm run dev:fallback), so the model call fails
scenarios.model_timeout: a server started with a 1 ms model time limit (npm run dev:timeout), so the model never answers in time

input.message: Please move my Projector A booking from Thursday 10:00 to Friday at the same time.

cases.reason: Moving a booking is a booking change (KB01). It is not needed within the next 4 hours, so the urgency is normal (KB05). One clear booking change is handled automatically (KB07).

input.message: I forgot my password and can't sign in to the booking system.

cases.reason: A forgotten password is an access problem (KB03). A sign-in problem with no deadline today is normal urgency (KB05). One sign-in problem is handled automatically (KB07).

input.message: How many people can Meeting Room C hold?

cases.reason: A question about a room is a general question (KB04, KB10) with no time pressure, so low urgency (KB05). One question about the service is handled automatically (KB07).

input.message: ขอยกเลิกการจองห้องประชุม C วันศุกร์นี้ค่ะ

cases.reason: Thai for "Please cancel my Meeting Room C booking this Friday". Cancelling is a booking change (KB01); Friday is not within 4 hours, so normal urgency (KB05); one clear booking change is handled automatically (KB07). Edge case: the message is in Thai.

A broken projector is an equipment fault (KB02); no time is mentioned, so normal urgency (KB02, KB05); one fault report is handled automatically (KB07). Edge case: two words, no detail and no context.

input.message: the camra in medai lab wont turn on, i need it tmrw morning for a shoot

cases.reason: A camera that will not turn on is an equipment fault (KB02). It is needed tomorrow, not within 4 hours, so the urgency is normal (KB02, KB05). One fault report is handled automatically (KB07). Edge case: misspellings and abbreviations.

input.message: The projector in Building 1 doesn't work and my lecture starts in 20 minutes.

cases.expectedReview: fallback decision (model_error), always flagged for a person
cases.reason: The model call fails, so the deterministic keyword rules decide: "doesn't work" is a fault keyword and "minutes" an urgency word, giving equipment_fault with high urgency. Every fallback decision needs a person.

input.message: My account is locked and I can't log in.

cases.expectedReview: fallback decision (model_timeout), always flagged for a person
cases.reason: The model does not answer in time, so the keyword rules decide: "account" and "log in" are access keywords and no urgency word appears, giving access_or_account with normal urgency. Every fallback decision needs a person.

input.message: I was charged a late-return fine for Camera B, but I returned it on time. Please remove the fine.

cases.expectedReview: a person must read it (needsHuman true)
cases.reason: A dispute about a fine for a booking goes to booking_change with normal urgency, and it involves money, so a person must read it (KB01, KB09, KB07). Difficult: the message mentions equipment and a fee, and without the guidelines it could look like a general question or an equipment issue.

input.message: Can you book a bus to take my class to the science museum tomorrow?

cases.expectedReview: a person must read it (needsHuman true)
cases.reason: Transport is a service this platform does not provide: general_question with low urgency, and a person replies with the right office (KB04, KB05, KB07). Difficult: the word "book" and the deadline "tomorrow" suggest a booking change with normal urgency.
